authority.provider: Ministry of Digital Affairs, Taiwan, CNS11643 Chinese Standard Interchange Code Full Character Database

visual_copybook.usage: independently rasterized topology comparison only; no outline, coordinate, or trace enters an image-generated glyph

policy.pass_definition: The exact requested scalar is present, its visible Taiwan Traditional topology agrees with the current CNS mapping and stroke-sequence structure, it remains directly recognizable at native, 128, 64, and 32 px cell sizes, the ink is isolated from the grid, and no stray thorn or topology-changing defect is visible.
policy.reject_definition: Any uncertain identity, simplified substitution, missing or extra semantic component, topology-changing join, unreadability at a reviewed size, grid contact, stray ink, or thorn-like defect.
policy.raster_limit: A final raster can establish visible branches and topology but cannot prove the temporal act of writing each official stroke. A natural handwriting join is accepted only when every required branch remains credible and the join cannot change the character.
policy.vectorization_limit: PASS permits controlled tracing of isolated dark ink only. Grid lines, near-white background variation, antialias halos, and CNS copybook outlines are forbidden geometry.
policy.descriptor_mutation: This audit does not change source descriptors, approval metadata, or manifests.

method.resampling: Lanczos reduction of each complete isolated cell without ink-bbox fitting; nearest-neighbour enlargement was used only to inspect reduced or source pixels.
method.grid_detection: Exactly five long light-gray line groups per axis were detected by projection; no equal-grid fallback was used. Grid clearance is the minimum distance from a pixel darker than L=100 to the nearest detected cell boundary.
method.detached_speck_check: Eight-connected dark-ink components at L<100 were enumerated per raw cell; no component smaller than 20 source pixels was found.
artifact_review: Taiwan Traditional topology and visible stroke branches
method.background_note: The paper is visually clean but not numerically flat #FFFFFF. Pixels at L>=245 have standard deviation 1.19 to 1.23 across the four sheets, so background normalization is mandatory before tracing.
